name: @avatark/world-embodiment-runtime
description: Deterministic World -> Embodiment projection (spatial layout, environment/entity/encounter presentation resolvers, embodiment delta engine, interaction-intent legality validation). Never advances simulation, never mutates world truth. Host-neutral: authors no world content, hardcodes no franchise behavior.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/spatialLayout.test.ts src/environmentPresentationResolver.test.ts src/entityPresentationResolver.test.ts src/encounterPresentationResolver.test.ts src/worldEmbodimentResolver.test.ts src/embodimentDelta.test.ts src/interactionIntentValidation.test.ts src/unrealCommandTranslator.test.ts src/capabilityNegotiation.test.ts src/alternateWorldEmbodiment.test.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
